verdict.rationale: The evidence shows name.com publishes a TLD price list with account-level, original, and retail pricing tiers. That is ordinary price transparency, not an at-cost or wholesale claim. Nothing in the pack shows a registry fee breakdown or a published low-margin guarantee, and a community note that it costs less than GoDaddy does not establish near-wholesale pricing.

support.subject: As a power user, pricing is at or near wholesale — at-cost claims backed by visible registry fee breakdowns or a published low-margin guarantee
